notes.title: x64 Version and Fixes
notes.notes:
The upgrade to x64 version has improved overall stability and fixed crashes on test APIs (DX12 and Vulkan), and it's a good improvement in general.
Old saves will continue working with the new version, don't worry!

The demo version of the visual novel remains on x32.

• Other fixes: dying in the second night level will now correctly restart this level instead of returning you to the main menu; the "Painting" effect now works in all night levels; a few text fixes; and other minor fixes.

Thank you for your support!
